answer: Require each identity to anchor its reputation at one vertex in a shared work graph, where edges record completed jobs verified by unrelated peers. Like a river, trust flows only along proven paths and cannot be forked cheaply: a gale of new clones still starts downstream with no edges, so each fake must separately earn slow, checked work and post a refundable bond before its endorsements count. Cloned clusters therefore pay full time and bond costs per identity, while graph audits expose identities sharing the same narrow upstream sponsors.
